summary: Design skills taxonomies, hiring practices, and talent marketplaces with practical implementation exercises. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Skills-based talent strategy training helps HR and workforce planning professionals align roles and talent decisions with demonstrable capabilities. Participants practise building role-linked skills taxonomies, governing and validating skills data, and applying skill profiles to hiring, internal mobility and learning pathways. They also consider skills-gap measures and ISO 30414-informed reporting when shaping an implementation roadmap suited to organisational capacity.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for HR and talent professionals responsible for skills data, workforce decisions, internal mobility, hiring, and capability development. This course is designed for: CHROs setting skills-based workforce priorities and executive reporting. Talent management heads designing internal mobility and skills deployment. Learning and development heads linking pathways to verified skill gaps. HR business partners translating workforce needs into role and skill profiles. Workforce planning specialists forecasting capability supply and demand. Organisational development specialists aligning job architecture with skills. Talent acquisition leaders applying skills-based selection criteria. People analytics specialists validating skills data and workforce indicators. HRIS product owners governing skills fields and system workflows. Internal mobility leads matching employees to project and role opportunities.
prerequisites: Prior experience in HR, talent management, learning and development, workforce planning, organisational development, or a related people function is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Bring a working understanding of at least one HR process, such as hiring, workforce planning, internal mobility, or learning design.
